items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: Well, Joe Phillips, Professor Houston, himself, jazzed in the trumpet.

ctx.x: Who, do you remember who played in band this particular time?

Well, Joe Phillips, Professor Houston, himself, jazzed in the trumpet. Yes, he played the trumpet. Joe Phillips. Uh, Hold It Sam. Was a wonderful saxophone player. A big saxophone player. A bass saxophone player. A bass saxophone player? He took a little, big saxophone. They used to call it Hold It Sam. He used to hold that note, you know? Oh, I see.
